en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3511 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Sulaiman ibn Khalid, who narrated from some of the Imams (as), peace be upon them:
"When a man died and had a wife who was a slave, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) would purchase her from his estate, emancipate her, and then make her an heir."
